function.name: getMachine
function.description: Read one machine by its identifier.

machineId.description: Machine identifier; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. MCH-1001

fields.description: Optional projection: subset of record keys to return; allowed keys: machineId, name, status, location; omit for full records

function.name: listMaintenance
function.description: List maintenance records for a machine.

machineId.description: Machine identifier; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. MCH-1001

after.description: Only maintenance after this instant; full instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with zone Z or +HH:MM, never date-only

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows

function.name: getPart
function.description: Read one part by its identifier.

partId.description: Part identifier; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. PRT-1101

fields.description: Optional projection: subset of record keys to return; allowed keys: partId, name, stock, supplier; omit for full records

function.name: listProduction
function.description: List production runs by status and/or date.

status.description: Production status; one of: running, completed, failed, scheduled

date.description: Production date; date-only YYYY-MM-DD, never a timestamp

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows
